therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: proteasome inhibition combined with alkylating agent and corticosteroid
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: plasma cell apoptosis and multiple myeloma cell death
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: confirmed response rate (CR, nCR, or VGPR) after 4 months

results.effect_size: 20/33 (60.6%) in 1.3mg/m² group, 18/30 (60.0%) in 1.5mg/m² group achieved CR/nCR/VGPR
subgroup_findings: Similar response rates between 1.3mg/m² and 1.5mg/m² bortezomib doses
results.dose_information: First 33 patients: bortezomib 1.3mg/m² IV days 1,4,8,11; Remaining 30 patients: bortezomib 1.5mg/m² IV days 1,8,15,22; cyclophosphamide 300mg/m² PO days 1,8,15,22; dexamethasone 40mg PO with schedule modifications

context.comparator: dose comparison between two bortezomib schedules
